_comment: Confirmed starting quarterbacks, overriding what the model infers from
play-by-play. Needed because starters are inferred from last season's
snaps, so no data source can see an offseason trade or signing until the
player takes a snap for the new team.
Keys are nflverse team codes; values are nflverse passer names in
'F.Lastname' form. A name must match exactly one passer in the history or
the run fails loudly rather than quietly predicting with the wrong man.
The player's rating always comes from their own career, whichever team
they earned it on. Only the team assignment is being corrected here.
